citations.claim: light body pressed against wall region moving with pusher before tunneling
first violating step: light body centre teleported to far side of thin wall

counterfactual.change: Reduced pusher body 0 vx from 60 to 5 (one field); slow squeeze resolves without tunneling.

explanation: Heavy body (m=20, vx=60) pins light body (m=0.2) against thin 0.1-wide wall. At step 1 both move ~59.4 m/s with the pair overlapping (gap -0.001) and the light body 0.10 from the wall. The contact solver then ejects the trapped light body through the wall: at step 2 it is at x=10.82, past the wall span [10,10.1], while the heavy body stops at the wall. Likely cause: body-body impulse/positional correction fires the squeezed body at high velocity into/through the thin wall within one step, and wall collision handling fails to stop the far-side crossing.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 1 and 2

vision_note: In step 1 the large blue body catches the small red body against the vertical wall. In step 2 the blue body stops at the wall while the red body appears on the far side of the wall, having crossed through it.
